name: Nervous Wasp 81
author: guilhermeyohan
description: A toggle switch with switch styling.
howItWorks: Click it to switch it on or off — it holds its state until you click it again.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nervous Wasp 81</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by guilhermeyohan - https://uiverse.io/guilhermeyohan/nervous-wasp-81 */
/* From Uiverse.io by guilhermeyohan - Tags: switch */
#toggle_checkbox {
  display: none;
}

label {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  display: block;
  width: 70px;
  height: 30px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  cursor: pointer;
}

label:before {
  top: 2px;
  left: 3px;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border: 3px solid rgb(2, 169, 38);
}

label:after {
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 70px;
  height: 30px;
  border: 3px solid #103445;
}

label:before, label:after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transition: 0.5s ease top, 0.5s ease left, 0.5s ease right, 0.5s ease width, 0.5s ease height, 0.5s ease border-color;
}

#toggle_checkbox:checked + label:before {
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 70px;
  height: 30px;
  border-color: #143240;
}

#toggle_checkbox:checked + label:after {
  top: 2px;
  right: 3px;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-color: red;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input id="toggle_checkbox" type="checkbox">
  <label for="toggle_checkbox"></label>
</body>
</html>
